**Minecraft 26.1.x · Fabric** — one build for the whole 26.1 line: **26.1, 26.1.1 and 26.1.2**.

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Simple Voice Chat (on the server)
- Java 25

### Install
Drop the `.jar` into your `mods` folder (together with Fabric API). Press **V** in game to open the configurator, or use Mod Menu.

### Notes
The mod declares `minecraft "~26.1"`, so Fabric loads it on 26.1 / 26.1.1 / 26.1.2 (and not on 26.2 — use the 26.2 release for that). Compiled against 26.1.2; verified to load and run in-game on a 26.1.2 runtime.

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Simple Voice Chat (on the server)
- Java 25

### Install
Drop the `.jar` into your `mods` folder (together with Fabric API). Press **V** in game to open the configurator, or use Mod Menu.

### Notes
Minecraft 26.x ships unobfuscated, so this is a dedicated build for 26.2 — it will not run on 1.21.x (use the matching release for your version). Verified in-game: the mod loads, the overlay and the configurator render correctly.

releases.notes:
Client-side Simple Voice Chat overlay showing who is speaking near you: face, name and a loudness-reactive waveform. Draggable HUD, in-game configurator with HSV+hex colour pickers and a live preview, keybinds, Mod Menu, EN/PL.

**Requirements:** Fabric Loader, Fabric API, Simple Voice Chat >= 2.6.0 (also on the server). Mod Menu optional. Client-side only.

**Install:** put Fabric API, Simple Voice Chat and the jar below into your `mods` folder. Open the configurator with **V** or via Mod Menu.
